items.comment: Accurate and reads fine as a standalone summary, but it undersells the class's purpose compared to the sibling AbstractFunction0 doc, which explains *why* the class exists ("allowing a function value to be defined by extending a class rather than the trait"). Here we only get the specialization detail, not the class-vs-trait rationale. Not wrong, just thinner than the established pattern for this family of docs. Optional: prefix with an article ("A base class...") to match AbstractFunction0's phrasing.
